item.tib: lha mo chen mo gnam gyi phyi / nyi zla skyabs mdzod gung gi brgyan / gza' bdud sgrol mdzad mched brgyad sprul / khyab 'jug sgral ba spyi'i gzungs
item.note: the colophon on fol. 4v1, as well as the final colophon, both mention zhu-g.yas rnam-rgyal grags-pa. these texts are aural transmissions to rong-bon g.yung-drung 'od-zer
